registryEvidence.custodian: Ekiti State Geospatial Data Center (EK-SGDC), with the Ekiti State Bureau of Land Services and Office of the Surveyor-General identified by the state government as land/GIS custodians.
registryEvidence.scope: Local/state land administration, cadastral and geospatial program evidence exists for Ekiti State; coverage of Omuo-Obadore and publication of parcel features were not independently demonstrated.

parcelEvidence.extent: Not tested against a parcel service because no public parcel/map service endpoint was exposed by the inspected official pages.
parcelEvidence.note: Absence of retained geometry is an evidence limitation, not evidence of citywide parcel absence. The supplied WUP point was not shifted.
